message.content:
This magazine cover features a black background with several graphic elements and text. At the top, a large red "TEMPO" logo is prominently displayed, underlined by the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" in smaller red capitals. Above the logo, two headlines in white text are separated by a thin vertical line: "Main Kayu Menyelamatkan Sritex H.64" and "Mengejar Sponsor Harun Masiku H.76".

The central visual is a dark, stylized silhouette of a bird’s head and wing, reminiscent of a Garuda. A bright, white starlike burst of light is positioned near the center of the silhouette, where a wing joint might be. On the left side, the bold white text reads "HABIS GELAP TERBITLAH GELAP". Below it, a paragraph in smaller white text describes student demonstrations and government policies.

At the bottom left, there is a white barcode and a QR code. The bottom right displays the date "24 FEBRUARI-2 MARET 2025", the price "RP 60.000", the website "TEMPO.CO/MINGGUAN", and the publication title "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN". An ISSN number is also visible.
